purpose: Freeze development vs held-out sequence identities before Round-2 multi-sequence validation.

development.rationale: Round-2 evidence-aware fusion policy and thresholds were already developed on the first 600 frames of MOT17-04; the entire logical sequence is therefore excluded from held-out claims.

held_out.rule: Do not use held-out metrics to retune evidence thresholds or fusion settings in Round 2.

separate_dense_safety.role: Detection/crowd/dense-safety validation only; no tracking metrics and no MOT17 threshold tuning.
